Lab notes

Bench technicians must torque the coupling bolt to no more than forty newton metres before releasing the unit for testing.

The pump receives its preventive maintenance visit every week without regard to how many hours it has actually run.

Feeler gauges are used to confirm the impeller sits three tenths of a millimetre clear of the housing wall.

The bench itself was resurfaced last spring and now has a bright yellow safety stripe painted along its front edge.
